title: Proj of a graded ring is separated
statement: Let $C=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}C_n$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, and let $P=\operatorname{Proj}(C)$ be its Proj scheme [def-nagata-affine-proj]. The scheme $P$ is separated: its canonical structural morphism $P\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism].
